name: Savage Terrain Warrior
body:
You attack with wild abandon when in a favored terrain, trusting in your connection to that terrain to aid you in the destruction of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, base attack bonus +3, favored terrain class feature.

Benefit(s): When in any of your favored terrains, you gain a +2 morale bonus on all attack rolls, damage rolls, and combat maneuver checks. Such recklessness, however, bestows a –3 penalty to your armor class. You must choose to use this feat before making an attack roll, and its effects last until the start of your next turn.
